title:
One alert.
The whole picture.
label: 01 / INVESTIGATE
detail:
A working incident agent
with FalkorDB at its core.
narration: Checkout is failing. But customer exposure does not stop at the service that raised the alert. BlastRadius follows the relationships behind an incident and makes its response explainable.

title:
3 customers.
420 thousand dollars.
label: 02 / MAP EXPOSURE
detail:
Annual revenue exposed.
Not confirmed losses.
narration: The graph policy agent follows live FalkorDB queries to a recent Payments deployment. Three customers are connected to that failure point, representing four hundred and twenty thousand dollars in synthetic annual revenue exposure.

title:
Every answer
has a path.
label: 03 / TRACE THE EVIDENCE
detail:
Customer → service → dependency
The complete relationship chain.
narration: Northstar reaches Payments through Storefront and Checkout. The graph also finds the response owner and a previous incident. These are source-backed hypotheses, not proof that the deployment caused the outage.

title:
Open the query.
Inspect the result.
label: 04 / VERIFY
detail:
Actual Cypher, parameters,
and database rows.
narration: Open the query trace to inspect the actual Cypher, parameters, and returned records. Source links expose the synthetic service catalog and deployment telemetry. The evidence can be checked independently of the wording.

title:
One new edge.
One more customer.
label: 05 / CHANGE THE CONTEXT
narration: Now add one relationship: Analytics depends on Payments. A fresh investigation discovers Cedar Health. Exposure rises to four customers and six hundred and thirty thousand dollars. The coordination step changes because the graph changed.

title:
Resolve today.
Remember tomorrow.
label: 06 / PERSIST THE OUTCOME
detail:
Incidents, tickets, and outcomes
stored in FalkorDB.
narration: Create a local ticket and record an observed outcome. Incidents and outcomes persist in FalkorDB. This was verified across a database container replacement, so the next session can retrieve what happened.

title:
Know when
to gather evidence.
label: 07 / ACT WITH CONTEXT
detail:
No supporting change?
No rollback recommendation.
narration: With the extra dependency removed, Analytics has no recent supporting change. The agent asks for more evidence instead of recommending rollback. This walkthrough uses the graph policy mode; live model analysis is an optional, separately configured tool agent.
